hyp-1.note: title: IL-23 receptor signalling via TYK2 and TRAF3IP2 drives psoriasis; one claim per gene in the hypothesis. IL12B and IL23R enter only through unsigned binds steps, and TRAF3IP2 only through an unsigned association, so only TYK2 has a signed route

hyp-2.note: the title names EGFL8 variants, but the chain starts at the gene; the only step is the gene-level effect

findings.detail: hyp-1.3 ends at the Th17 response and hyp-1.4 starts at TRAF3IP2, a side branch into the same node; the mechanism's 'TRAF3IP2 acts downstream in IL-23 / IL-17 signalling' is never a step, so TRAF3IP2 is not on the IL12B-IL23R-TYK2 path at all.

IL12B and IL23R enter hyp-1 only through 'binds' steps with unknown polarity, so the claim that IL-23 receptor signalling drives psoriasis has no signed route from IL12B or IL23R; render reports no route for both.
Of hyp-1's four genes only TYK2 composes to psoriasis (S3 then S5); IL12B and IL23R stop at binding, and TRAF3IP2's only link is an undirected association with the Th17 response.

TYK2 required for the Th17 response is cited to a STRING GO enrichment row and an Open Targets TYK2-psoriasis score; neither states the step, so S3 has no evidence; with S5 also unsupported, the only composed arm of hyp-1 (S3 then S5) rests on nothing for either link.

TRAF3IP2 ~ Th17 response is cited to a Reactome IL-23 signalling enrichment that does not say which 3 genes matched, and to a text-mining-only IL23R-TRAF3IP2 STRING edge (0.58); neither names TRAF3IP2 with the Th17 response.

None of the three citations for Th17 response -> psoriasis states it: the review abstract PMID:30909615 only implies psoriasis is among 'chronic inflammatory diseases with a dominant IL-23/Th17 axis' (a feature, no direction), and the GWAS abstract PMID:23143594 and the TRAF3IP2 Open Targets score do not mention Th17.
EGFL8 -> psoriasis is cited only to three GWAS variant rows and an undirected Open Targets score; none states a gene-level effect, so hyp-2's only statement has no evidence.

The three GWAS rows place rs3117182, rs117689957 and rs206018 in the MHC region (6p21.32-33), at distance 0 from TNXB, TNXB and NOTCH4 respectively, with EGFL8 42-96 kb away and never flagged as the closest gene; the run calls them 'variants mapped to the EGFL8 locus' with no fine-mapping, eQTL or functional step to justify EGFL8 over ~20 neighbouring genes.
rs117689957's risk allele is '?' in its GWAS row, so its beta (0.43 increase) cannot be assigned to an allele; the run still counts it as a risk-increasing EGFL8 variant.

hyp-2 is a single gene -> disease 'leads_to' step with a 'currently uncharacterized' mechanism, inferred from variant associations alone; the Open Targets record gives EGFL8 a literature score of 0.01, so nothing the run cites bears on EGFL8 biology.

Both hypotheses are 'low' / 'speculative', though hyp-1's two binding steps are curatedDb-supported and TYK2's Open Targets row shows a clinical score of 0.94, while hyp-2 rests on association rows for a gene that is not the closest to any of its variants (EGFL8 literature score 0.01).
The run grounds only psoriasis (MONDO:0005083); every gene and the Th17 response have an empty curie, and the Th17 response, a GO process (GO:0072538), has kind 'other'.
Neither hypothesis lists supporting or contradicting evidence outside its chain; hyp-2 does not discuss that its own cited rows put the variants in the MHC, next to genes other than EGFL8.
The question names skin of body (UBERON:0002097) as the tissue; no step, context or note mentions skin, keratinocytes or any tissue.

The run abstains on GLE1 and UHRF2 citing GWAS:GLE1:no-association, GWAS:UHRF2:no-association, OT:GLE1-tractability, OT:UHRF2-tractability and reactome:coverage; none is in sources.json (sources.py fetches only chain, supporting and contradicting citations), and curated.json has no place for an abstention, so the negative claim cannot be checked or recorded.

The STRING enrichment row for GO:2000318 lists TYK2 among the input genes annotated to 'positive regulation of T-helper 17 type immune response', a signed curated GO annotation; the format can only exclude the row as enrichment, with no kind for the annotation it carries.
No exclusion category says 'the variant is not in or nearest to the gene the step names'; association_only and not_this_entity each cover half of what is wrong with the EGFL8 GWAS rows.

A ligand-receptor-kinase cascade written as binds, binds, required_for composes only from its last signed node: rel statements never join an arm, so a receptor-complex hypothesis gets no route from its upstream components even when each binding is well supported (S1, S2 are curatedDb).

The GO definition of GO:0072538 names psoriasis ('associated with pathological autoimmune conditions such as ... psoriasis'), but textbook evidence is for bridges only, so a definition that bears on a run step cannot be recorded on it (here it would be association_only anyway).

Open Targets rows bundle literature, genetic and clinical datatypes into one undirected score; TYK2's clinical 0.94 implies directed drug evidence, but the whole row can only be excluded as no_direction or not_in_text.

IL23R binds TYK2 rests on a STRING edge with experimental 0.00 (database 0.80, text-mining 0.90), while the corpus UniProt records say IL23R interacts with JAK2 and TYK2's receptor chain is IL12RB1; the step skips IL12RB1, the chain that actually links the IL-23 receptor to TYK2.

The run puts TRAF3IP2 into the Th17 response ('acts downstream in the interleukin-23 signaling network'), but its UniProt record makes it an essential adapter in IL17A signalling at IL17RA/IL17RC, i.e. downstream of the cytokine Th17 cells make, not of IL-23R; the only cited link to IL-23 is a text-mining-only STRING edge (0.58).

The guide counts a STRING database channel >= 0.15 as curatedDb for binds, so S2 is kept as curatedDb on database 0.80 with experimental 0.00, although STRING's database channel includes pathway co-membership and the curated UniProt record for IL23R names JAK2, not TYK2.

hyp-2 claims germline susceptibility, but its falsification test reads out severity after EGFL8 knockdown in a model that already has psoriasis, and assumes the risk alleles are gain-of-function, which nothing cited shows (all three variants are intergenic to EGFL8; no eQTL or coding change is cited).
The abstention says GLE1 and UHRF2 'lack disease association scores in Open Targets' but cites OT:GLE1-tractability and OT:UHRF2-tractability, records of druggability, not of disease association.
The question's budget sets min_hypotheses 3, but the run returns 2 hypotheses plus an abstention on GLE1 and UHRF2.

audit.before: kept, kind review, quote '...providing fundamental insights into the pathogenesis of chronic inflammatory diseases with a dominant IL-23/Th17 axis'
audit.reason: The span never says the Th17 response causes or raises psoriasis: psoriasis is only implied to be one of the 'diseases with a dominant IL-23/Th17 axis', a characterisation with no direction. The curator's own note called it 'only implicit'; the guide requires the text to state both ends and the direction.

audit.item: findings on hyp-1.3, hyp-1.5 and hyp-2 confidence
audit.before: hyp-1.3: arm 'rests on nothing for its first link'; hyp-1.5: 'only the review abstract PMID:30909615 states it'; confidence: 'hyp-1's genes carry the run's only directly stated step (PMID:30909615)'
audit.after: rewritten: neither link of the TYK2 arm has evidence; none of the three hyp-1.5 citations states the step; confidence finding now rests on the curatedDb binding steps and the Open Targets scores
audit.reason: These three findings depended on PMID:30909615 being kept, which it no longer is.

audit.after: hypothesis-agent finding: IL23R-TYK2 binding has experimental 0.00; UniProt names JAK2 for IL23R and IL12RB1 for TYK2
audit.reason: The corpus UniProt subunit and function texts (terms.py UniProt:Q5VWK5, UniProt:P29597) contradict the pairing the run's step asserts.

audit.after: hypothesis-agent finding: TRAF3IP2 is an IL17A-receptor adapter, downstream of the Th17 response's cytokine, not of IL-23R
audit.reason: UniProt:O43734 function text places TRAF3IP2 at IL17RA/IL17RC; the run's note and step put it upstream of or into the Th17 response.

audit.after: biolean finding: the database-channel rule gives curatedDb weight to a binding no curated record states
audit.reason: S2 is curatedDb only through STRING's database channel (experimental 0.00), which includes pathway co-membership.

audit.after: hypothesis-agent finding: severity readout in a disease model cannot test a susceptibility claim; gain-of-function assumption uncited
audit.reason: run.json hyp-2 falsification text versus its title and the GWAS rows (EGFL8 intergenic for all three variants).

audit.reason: The evidence ids in run.json abstention name tractability, not association.
